entities.name: Robert Kerr, 1st Marquess of Lothian

entities.summary: Robert Kerr, 1st Marquess of Lothian, known as the 4th Earl of Lothian from 1675 to 1701, was a Scottish nobleman. He was styled Lord Kerr until 1661 and Lord Newbattle from 1661 to 1675.
